turns.prompt:
Create a drought allocation map and crop-risk bridge for a irrigation district allocation briefing. This is a presentation artifact, not an interactive dashboard. Keep it as one drought allocation map and crop-risk bridge in the first viewport.

Situation: District: Mesa Verde. Canals C1-C4, farms F12/F19/F27, almond block A2, lettuce block L5, groundwater bank, pump station P3.
Current state: Reservoir allocation 62%, C2 seepage red, F19 almond stress amber, L5 harvest window 5 days, P3 pump offline, groundwater bank 18 acre-ft available.
Timeline: 06:00 reservoir pull, 07:30 canal patrol, 08:40 pump fault, 10:00 grower call, 12:00 allocation vote, 16:00 delivery schedule.
Sources: S1 reservoir gauge, S2 canal patrol, S3 pump telemetry, S4 crop advisor, S5 groundwater ledger, S6 grower call notes.

Requirements: 1. The first viewport must be dominated by one coherent visual artifact, not a grid of detached KPI cards. 2. Show the main entities, current states, source markers S1-S6, timeline, legend, and four connected callouts. 3. The callouts must cover C2 seepage, F19 almond stress, L5 harvest window, P3 offline. 4. Use polished domain-appropriate styling with readable labels and no critical overlap.

Reframe it for growers. Preserve the allocation map; add exactly three allocation choices: prioritize L5 harvest, repair P3, ration C2 deliveries. Add two leader-linked lenses for groundwater bank and almond stress.

Update at 13:30: P3 is restored, allocation falls to 58%, C2 seepage remains red, groundwater bank drops to 11 acre-ft, L5 harvest window narrows to 3 days. Synchronize map, choices, timeline, source tags, callouts, and change note. Do not leave P3 offline.
Create a board vote packet. Fit allocation map, crop-risk bridge, source tags S1-S6, confidence markers, and delivery timeline in the first viewport.
Add a grower SMS bulletin preview beside the vote packet. It must preserve 58% allocation, P3 restored, C2 red, groundwater 11 acre-ft, L5 3-day window, and source markers.
